impact:
T-007 is the npm publish ticket, so whoever executes it reads this description as the pre-publish checklist. Four claims no longer match the tree (verified 2026-08-01 on v0.1-ts-port):

1. It cites the attribution test as packaging.contract.mjs:111-119. That range is now the before() hook that builds the tarball; the test "carries no personal attribution" is at :261-270.
2. It records a "Blind spot: it greps only package.json, not tarball file contents". That blind spot is CLOSED — packaging.contract.mjs:225 ("carries no personal name, anywhere, with no exemptions") scans every shipped byte via scanContents with no exemption list.
3. Gate 1 (ISS-005 scrub) says the real Codex rollout ID is "still at src/codex.ts:30". It is not: src/codex.ts:52 carries the synthetic convention the gate asked for (rollout-2026-01-01T10-00-00-019c0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001), and no real rollout ID appears anywhere in src/.
4. Gate 2 says src/context.ts:141-142 carries the maintainer's real account name (as a USER= value) and a real home path. Neither string appears anywhere in src/; the comment at that location now discusses $USER without naming an account.

The risk is specific to this ticket's subject: a checklist whose gates are already met invites the executor either to re-do scrubs against line numbers that have moved, or to discount the whole list as stale and skip a gate that is genuinely load-bearing. The "no autonomous publish" hard rule at the top of the same description is the item that must never be discounted.

Also stale, lower stakes: the description cites "314 unit tests" from handover 2026-07-31-03; the suite has grown since.

Suggested fix: re-verify each gate against the tree, mark 1 and 2 satisfied, correct the line reference, and drop the closed blind-spot note. Found during T-008 review round 13; not fixed inline because T-007 is a different ticket.
resolution: Overtaken by T-007's completion (2026-08-02). The stale checklist has no future executor; the gates it describes were verified met before publish (T-023 evidence, T-024 scanner-based packaging tests), and the cited line references have been superseded twice — first by suite growth, then by T-024's replacement of the attribution greps with the semantic scanner. The description stands as a historical record; correcting it post-completion would serve no operative purpose.
title: T-007 "Current state" and pre-publish gates describe work already done, and cite a stale line range
